mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sns_comment (board_id, user_no, parent_id, content) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{userNo}, #{parentId}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE sns_comment SET content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.board_id AS boardId, c.user_no AS userNo, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.content, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt, u.nickname AS nickName, u.user_img AS userImg FROM sns_comment c INNER JOIN user u ON c.user_no = u.user_no WHERE c.board_id = #{boardId} AND c.parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at ASC

SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.board_id AS boardId, c.user_no AS userNo, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.content, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt, u.nickname AS nickName, u.user_img AS userImg FROM sns_comment c INNER JOIN user u ON c.user_no = u.user_no WHERE c.parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC

SELECT comment_id AS commentId, board_id AS boardId, user_no AS userNo, parent_id AS parentId, content, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM sns_comment WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
